name: Quality engine
what: Measures the weakest thing people see (looks, 3D, speed, phone, and whether it is right), ships one fix, re-scores the live page, and keeps the change only if the score rose. It makes new things too, and upgrades itself when its rate of improvement flattens.
schedule: with every house lane run, about every 2 hours
last: Measured 2 surfaces; the board holds 22 with an average of 71 of 100 and 0 at the pinnacle. Vision judge: unjudged (cf HTTP 401, gemini HTTP 404), so visual scores stay capped at 85. Charter: whole. Next to make: an ask typed 1 time (1, gaps list) [no VOID_MISSES_TOKEN here, so the ask bar misses were not read]. Showcase: held back: no judge has seen the post picture yet
